autonomous_decisions.label: autonomous
autonomous_decisions.issue: PRD 00010 design: how to stop the target repo running its own configured programs (core.fsmonitor, filter.*.clean/process) during a read-only snapshot, including filter names containing =, spaces and dots, from every config scope and in submodules.
autonomous_decisions.action: Neutralize at the single _git choke point: core.fsmonitor=false as a static override, plus per-repository discovery of effective filter.*.(clean|process|required) keys and empty-value overrides carried through the GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_n/VALUE_n env transport. Discovery cached per realpath so submodules discover independently; discovery failures fail closed to exit 2. _dirty keeps its -c core.bigFileThreshold=1m unchanged.
autonomous_decisions.reason: Command-line -c cannot express a filter name containing = (git parses filter.a=b.clean=x as key filter.a), which is exactly how the parked attempt was bypassed. Measured on git 2.56.0: -c beats the env transport for the same key, the later GIT_CONFIG_COUNT index wins, an empty value disables a filter without spawning anything, and an unscoped git config --includes --get-regexp reaches local, global, include.path, matching includeIf, worktree and submodule config. 3 review dispatches (1 claude, 2 claude-fallback after codex sandbox failure), 4 blockers raised and all fixed, 0 open.
unresolved_non_blockers: VERSION stays 4 while the dirty map values change on a normalizing-filter target, so a cross-build v4 compare can report spurious tracked violations; planning must either bump VERSION to 5 or record snapshot/compare as a contractual same-build pair
_filter_overrides must pass allow_fail=True and classify exit codes itself (1 = no match, 6 = invalid pattern, 128 = broken include.path)
an inherited GIT_TRACE2 pointing inside the target would write there, contradicting the module docstring; out of scope for this PRD
the includeIf gitdir realpath trap recorded in the review log is a false premise: git matches both the unresolved and the resolved gitdir
Data flow step 4 and _inherited_config_pairs describe two different fates for a hostile inherited filter pair; both hold

autonomous_decisions.label: autonomous
autonomous_decisions.issue: Design review carried one open non-blocker to planning: target_snapshot VERSION stays 4 while the dirty map VALUES change on a normalizing-filter target, so a v4 snapshot taken before this change and compared after it can report spurious tracked violations (exit 1) on an untouched repo. The operator s own global config declares filter.lfs.clean/process/required, so every target discovers and disables lfs.
autonomous_decisions.action: Do NOT bump VERSION. Task 3 pins VERSION at 4 and records the cross-build comparison as out of contract.
autonomous_decisions.reason: Simplest safe assumption, and two PRD facts decide it: the PRD requires snapshot output for an ordinary repo to be unchanged (a bump changes it), and snapshot/compare are contractually a same-build pair in agoge s own use (the master takes the snapshot and compares it within one run). Bumping would also force an edit to test_previous_version_snapshot_exits_2_with_one_line, widening the diff for a hazard the product never hits.

autonomous_decisions.issue: `_base_env` preserves `GIT_CONFIG`, which can redirect `git config` discovery to an empty file while `git status` still reads repository filters. This leaves configured programs executable. Strip `GIT_CONFIG` and add a marker regression with an empty alternate config, proving the bare-status control fires and snapshot/compare suppress it.

`test_snapshot_does_not_run_fsmonitor`, `test_snapshot_does_not_run_clean_filter`, `test_snapshot_does_not_run_clean_filter_named` and `test_snapshot_does_not_run_clean_filter_from_any_source` each inline the positive-control block (status, assert log non-empty, unlink). `_assert_program_ran` was extracted for exactly that block, and the first two tests also inline what `_capture_untouched` does. Use the helpers.

Must-have says marker tests cover clean and process filters from local, global, included, conditional-include, worktree and submodule configuration. The source matrix `_FILTER_SOURCES` (test_target_snapshot.py:1547) configures only `filter.<x>.clean` through `_configure_filter`. The only process-filter marker test is local-only (`test_snapshot_does_not_run_required_process_filter`). The code treats clean and process identically, so the risk is low, but the matrix is incomplete.

`test_target_snapshot.py` is 1936 lines against the 800-line limit. It was already about 1280 lines before this diff, which adds 654. Splitting the does-not-run suite into `test_target_snapshot_programs.py` would fix it.
R3 (cycle 1): _base_env preserves GIT_CONFIG, so an inherited GIT_CONFIG blinds filter discovery while git status still runs the repo's clean filter
autonomous_decisions.reason: Reproduced directly by the decision gate (discovery exit 1 with GIT_CONFIG=empty file, marker still ran on git status), so it is not taken on Carl's contaminated consensus. It defeats the PRD's central must-have; the fix is additive (strip GIT_CONFIG, add a marker regression). Kept at opus because the PRD's default_model rationale is exactly git-config precedence.

autonomous_decisions.issue: `TEST_ENV` inherits the caller's `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` / `GIT_CONFIG_KEY_*` / `GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_*` command-scope pairs from `os.environ`, so an ambient `core.fsmonitor` override beats the repo-local one the fixture sets. `test_snapshot_does_not_run_fsmonitor` and `test_snapshot_does_not_run_submodule_only_fsmonitor` then fail on their positive control. Strip the command-scope family (and `GIT_CONFIG`) from `TEST_ENV`.
